searchText: Week 20+ Updates <@&857649635274915900> Thank you guys once again for a great EPF cohort this year. So much incredible work has been made and I am honored to see your progress, how much have you learned and contributed. Many of us met at Devcon last week but I wanted say once again a huge thank you to all of you for participating. I want to let you know that I am always available if you need something, always feel free to reach out. I am just getting back from India so I will get back to your final updates and reports these days, looking forward to see it! If you have not submitted it yet, feel free to do so - it's a great way to present and share your work for the future. Also if you still work on something, you can keep posting updates! I opened a thread above. Hope you all made it safely back home, got some rest and are ready for what comes next. Even if you couldn't make it this time, I am sure there will be more opportunities in the future. See you around the protocol 🫡 Hey <@686695036733227017> , just a quick ping! Could you check my DM when you have a chance? Thanks!
